cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: A Necessary Heartbreak
cards.instruction: Describe disappointment, rejection, or loss as the exact experience everyone needed in order to grow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've torn up the rejection letter like you. A fresh start for our bakery. Losing that contract was exactly what we needed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only tore off the address for recycling. We needed that contract to pay the mixer loan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, recycle the old plans. Now we can learn to manage without one enormous order. Help me list the smaller ones.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There aren't enough. The mixer will have to go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then get the bowls out with me. Losing it will teach us what our hands can still do.
